summary: Ospemifene carries the strongest type of warning from the FDA for heart problems, blood vessel harm, nerve damage, and cancer of the lining of the uterus [3][5]. Its label also warns about blood clots in the veins and risks related to severe liver problems or breast cancer [5]. A small computer model, rather than tests done in people, predicts medium risk scores for both liver and heart issues [M]. In addition, a similar drug named Toremifene has a strong warning for heart harm [4].
